interpretation.null_policy: empty cell or declared NODATA value is missing; never zero-filled

preserved: every trace header and sample byte for byte (the exact original is the stored representation)
every trace in file order with its trace number, source point and x and y
losses: Nothing is resampled; samples are not copied into the description
decisions: Textual header read as ASCII; card C6 carries the Ophiolite 2D seismic line marker.
Binary header bytes 3217–3218: sample interval 4000, read as microseconds, so 4 ms.
Binary header bytes 3221–3222: 4 samples per trace; every trace agrees.
Binary header bytes 3225–3226: data format 5 (IEEE 4-byte floating point), big-endian.
Trace header bytes 21–24: trace number, kept in file order for all 5 traces.
Trace header bytes 197–200: source point, scaled by bytes 201–202 (negative divides, positive multiplies).
Trace header bytes 181–184 and 185–188: x and y, scaled by the coordinate scalar -100 (bytes 71–72).
Trace header bytes 109–110: delay recording time 0 on every trace; sample k is at delay + k × interval.
Chunks are runs of at most 1024 whole traces by 0-based file ordinal.
Source point absent (value and scalar zero) on 1 trace, trace ordinals 3 to 3.
Source point scalar zero read as 1 on 1 trace, trace ordinals 4 to 4.
